premises.text: Cholera outbreaks can occur after disasters, leading to significant health impacts.
premises.evidence_span: there was no cholera for 100 years, until the earthquake happened in 2010. After the disaster, cholera spread through the country, creating outbreaks and deaths to this day.

premises.text: Cholera is a global issue with millions of cases and significant economic losses.
premises.evidence_span: there are five million cholera cases every year in 41 different countries, and this leads to $3 billion in losses from productivity, human cost, and therapy.

premises.text: Current cholera detection methods are slow, expensive, and require expertise.
premises.evidence_span: It takes seven days to detect four cholera in water. From the time a lab sends somebody out to get to the sample, bring it back, do isolation, enrichment, polymerase chain reaction, serology, TCBS streaking, and a secondary confirmation.

premises.text: OmniViz can detect cholera in water in under 30 minutes using a portable system.
premises.evidence_span: we put the power of the lab in the palm of your hand. And we do this by detecting four cholera in water, anywhere in the world, in under 30 minutes.

premises.text: The system includes a hardware component, disposable test kit, and smartphone app.
premises.evidence_span: We have a hardware component, disposable test kit, and a smartphone that works seamlessly together to detect cholera accurately and affordably.

premises.text: The hardware component functions as a portable laboratory for DNA amplification.
premises.evidence_span: The hardware acts like the portable laboratory. It has a heating unit in order to do DNA amplification, and it has microscope lenses to see down to the nanoparticle level.

premises.text: The test kit contains reagents for DNA amplification to detect cholera.
premises.evidence_span: The test kit has reagents inside for DNA amplification.

premises.text: The smartphone app provides real-time data on cholera outbreaks.
premises.evidence_span: we're able to see where and when cholera has happened, and notify people so that they can come in and eliminate the outbreak before it's too large.

premises.text: The company has pending patents for its viscosity detection technique.
premises.evidence_span: We have two pending patents for this viscosity technique.

premises.text: OmniViz's business model includes B2B sales and recurring revenue from test kits.
premises.evidence_span: We do a B2B sales model where our hardware is a single time purchase, and our disposable test kits create the recurring revenue as their single use.

premises.text: The market for cholera detection and surveillance is significant.
premises.evidence_span: Cholera is a two billion dollar market for water detection and surveillance.

premises.text: The technology can be adapted to detect other diseases beyond cholera.
premises.evidence_span: by using our novel IP, we change out the chemistry in our disposable test kits, and we can detect for many diseases in many different markets.

value.text: Rapid detection of cholera saves lives and improves public health.
value.evidence_span: Omniviz mobilizes the lab, rapidly detecting pathogens, saving lives.
